old: Who has the title to the land? It matters so much! Whoever has it has a massive amount of power over the community. If the deed is in the founder's name, then they're really a landlord with a philosophy. If three members out of twelve own everything, then there's effectively two classes of members even if the welcome packet says everyone's equal.
